faq.a: The best time depends on the season. From June to August, sunset occurs between 21:30 and 21:45 local time. In September, it's earlier, around 20:30–20:45. Plan to depart 30–45 minutes before sunset to enjoy the changing light and anchor for the golden hour.

For a luxury experience, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) includes a jet ski. Larger yachts like the Ferretti 94 or Canados 86 are available on request.

data.body_html:
Sotogrande is one of the Costa del Sol's most exclusive destinations, but its sunset yacht charter scene is often overlooked. Most cruises depart from Puerto Banús, 20 NM east, making it easy to combine a sunset sail with a stop at Estepona or Cala del Faro. This guide covers the best routes, timing, and boats for a sotogrande yacht charter sunset cruise — with concrete numbers and no fluff.

Why sunset cruises from Puerto Banús work for Sotogrande

Puerto Banús is the main departure point for our fleet, located roughly 40 minutes by boat from Sotogrande. The coastline west of Banús offers open views of the sunset over the Mediterranean, with the Sierra Bermeja mountains as a backdrop. Unlike the crowded eastern beaches near Marbella, this stretch is quieter, with fewer boats and more anchorages. A sunset cruise from here gives you the best of both worlds: easy access to Sotogrande's marina and the freedom to explore hidden coves.

Best times for a sunset cruise (by month)

Sunset times vary significantly across the season. Here's a practical table for planning:

MonthSunset time (local)Recommended departure
June21:4021:00–21:10
July21:4521:00–21:15
August21:3020:45–21:00
September20:3019:45–20:00

Depart 30–45 minutes before sunset to see the golden hour from the water. For a longer cruise, add 1–2 hours before sunset for swimming or a jet ski session.

Three recommended sunset routes

All routes start from Puerto Banús. Distances are one-way unless noted.

  • Route 1: Puerto Banús → Estepona (2 hours round trip) — Head west along the coast. Anchor off Estepona's old town for sunset views. Ideal for the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) or Azimut 39.
  • Route 2: Puerto Banús → Cala del Faro (3 hours) — A longer cruise to a secluded cove near the Punta Chullera lighthouse. Swim in calm waters as the sun sets. Works well with the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h includes jet ski).
  • Route 3: Puerto Banús → Sotogrande (4 hours) — Full round trip to Sotogrande Marina. Pass by the Sotogrande International School and the Río Guadiaro estuary. Best on a faster boat like the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax).

Which boat should you choose?

For a sunset cruise, comfort and speed matter. Here's a quick breakdown:

  • Budget-friendly (€749/2h): Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax). Both include skipper, drinks, and snacks. Perfect for couples or small groups.
  • Luxury with extras (€4,719/4h): Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or the grey variant. Both include a free jet ski — great for adrenaline before sunset.
  • Request pricing: Larger yachts like the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) or Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) are available via WhatsApp. Ideal for corporate events or celebrations.

What's included — and what's not

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, Spanish VAT (21%), water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. There are no hidden fees. You can bring your own food or arrange catering via WhatsApp. The skipper will anchor in a safe spot for swimming if you wish. Jet skis are only included with the Mangusta 80 packages.

Local tips for the perfect sunset

The best sunset views are west of Puerto Banús, towards Estepona and Sotogrande. Avoid staying too close to the marina — the light is better offshore. Bring a light jacket even in summer, as sea breezes cool down after sunset. For photographers, the golden hour starts about 30 minutes before sunset and lasts 20 minutes after. The reflection on the water near Cala del Faro is particularly striking.

How to book

For boats up to 12m (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), you can book directly online. For larger yachts, contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing. We recommend booking at least 3 days in advance during July and August. All prices are in euros and include VAT. No deposit is required for most boats; payment is on the day.
